name: @vscxml/mcp

tools.name: scxml_validate
tools.description: Validate SCXML against the W3C spec. When target is supplied, also returns structured target/datamodel compatibility diagnostics before generation. For Wasm, pass the same optional wasmProfile used for generation. Use source="editor" or source="file" to avoid passing raw SCXML content. Use suppress to hide specific warning IDs.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

target.description: Optional generation target for compatibility preflight

wasmProfile.description: Wasm target only: opt into a versioned direct-Wasm profile. Use full-hosted@1 for ECMAScript and host services, or finite-null-static@1 for restricted i32-only static run-to-completion. Omit for flat-null-memoryless@1 compatibility. Call scxml_list_targets for exact per-selector contracts.

tools.name: scxml_inspect
tools.description: Inspect an SCXML file and return its full structured model: states (with parent/child hierarchy), transitions (with guards and actions), events, data variables (with types and scopes), and datamodel type. Generated code also provides introspection APIs: getAllEvents(), getEnabledEvents() (guard-aware), getEventsForState(id), getEnabledEventsForState(id). Use source="editor" or source="file" to avoid passing raw SCXML content.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

tools.name: scxml_create
tools.description: Create a new SCXML state machine from a structured specification. Returns valid SCXML XML. This is easier than writing raw XML — specify states, transitions, and data as structured objects.

datamodel.description: Datamodel: ecmascript (default where supported), null (no data), xpath (Java only), or native-{target} for type-safe language-native variables

type.description: Action type: send, cancel, assign, script, raise, log, if, foreach

actions.description: Nested actions (for type="if" then-branch, or type="foreach" body)

onEntry.description: Entry actions: script string or [{type:"send", event:"x", delay:"500ms"}]

type.description: Action type: send, cancel, assign, script, raise, log, if, foreach

actions.description: Nested actions (for type="if" then-branch, or type="foreach" body)

onExit.description: Exit actions: script string or [{type:"cancel", sendid:"x"}]

target.description: Target state ID (space-separated for multi-target parallel entry, e.g. "A1 B1")

event.description: Trigger event (omit or null for eventless/automatic transitions)

type.description: Action type: send, cancel, assign, script, raise, log, if, foreach

actions.description: Nested actions (for type="if" then-branch, or type="foreach" body)
Transition actions: script string or [{type:"raise", event:"x"}]

scripts.description: Top-level <script> blocks for global helper functions and shared initialization (inserted as children of <scxml>, before states)

tools.name: scxml_generate_project
tools.description: Generate a complete runnable project for a target language. Unlike scxml_generate with codeOnly, this includes build files, runtime dependencies, and project scaffolding. Inline binary artifacts use base64 with an explicit encoding field. Use source="editor" or source="file" to avoid passing raw SCXML content. Set outputDir to write files to disk and avoid token overflow.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

plcPlatform.description: ST target only: codesys (default, 3rd ed. with METHODs), iec-strict (no pragmas/access modifiers), openplc (2nd ed. FUNCTIONs, no METHODs)

snapshot.description: Emit snapshot/restore hook overrides on the generated class (history map + native variable accessors). Pair with the language's SnapshotService at runtime. Off by default — non-snapshot consumers pay zero code-size or runtime cost.

hierarchy.description: Emit state-hierarchy metadata and navigation APIs. Off by default so generated output retains its lightweight code-size and runtime footprint.

wasmProfile.description: Wasm target only: opt into a versioned direct-Wasm profile. Use full-hosted@1 for ECMAScript and host services, or finite-null-static@1 for restricted i32-only static run-to-completion. Omit for flat-null-memoryless@1 compatibility. Call scxml_list_targets for exact per-selector contracts.

allowUnsupported.description: Expert override: generate an unsupported target/datamodel pair and preserve error diagnostics in generator.json and the tool result.

outputDir.description: Write project files to this directory instead of returning inline content. Recommended for large projects.

tools.name: scxml_sim_start
tools.description: Load SCXML into the simulator and start a session. Returns the initial active states, variables, enabled events, AND the identity of the loaded SCXML (scxmlHash, scxmlContentLength, machineName, stateCount) so callers can verify which document was picked up. Use source="editor" to simulate the document currently open in the editor (avoids resending the full SCXML), or source="file" to load from a file path. NOTE: When called repeatedly, the simulator replaces the underlying session model but keeps the same sessionId — check scxmlHash/scxmlContentLength to confirm new content was picked up. Use scxml_sim_status or scxml_sim_get_loaded_source at any time to re-check what is loaded. The simulator keeps a single session, so loading here replaces whatever that session held: an already connected editor stays attached and reports the document change (its document status becomes "Simulator changed") instead of being orphaned. Set connectEditor=true to attach an editor that is not connected yet.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content (source="inline") or file path (source="file"). Omit when using source="editor".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from the connected editor), or "file" (read from file path in scxml parameter)

connectEditor.description: Connect the editor to the simulator after starting, for the case where it is not attached yet. An already connected editor keeps its session and does not need this.

tools.name: scxml_sim_send
tools.description: Send a single event to the running simulation and return the resulting trace and new state. Set includeTrace=false to return only the state summary (saves tokens in loops). WARNING: If the machine uses <send delay="..."/> to generate events internally, do NOT send those same events externally — they will fire twice. Only send events representing external stimuli (e.g., button presses).

invokeId.description: Target a specific invoked child machine by its invoke ID. Omit to send to the parent machine.

includeTrace.description: Include trace entries in response. Set false to save tokens when you only need the resulting state.

tools.name: scxml_sim_stop
tools.description: Stop the active simulation and clear its runtime state while keeping the loaded SCXML available for a later start. Also disconnects the editor simulator panel when available. Safe to call repeatedly or when no session is loaded.

tools.name: scxml_sim_scenario
tools.description: Run a batch of events against a simulation and return the complete trace. This is the most useful tool for testing behavior — "send these events and show me what happens."

scxml.description: SCXML content (creates fresh session). Omit to use existing session.

source.description: Use source="editor" to simulate the editor document without resending SCXML

embedTrace.description: If provided, automatically embed the execution trace after the scenario completes

tools.name: scxml_sim_timed_scenario
tools.description: Run events with real-time delays between them. Unlike scxml_sim_scenario (instant), this lets delayed sends (<send delay="500ms"/>) fire between events — perfect for demonstrating real-time behavior. WARNING: Do NOT send events that the machine generates internally via <send delay="..."/>. Only send external stimuli (e.g., button presses). Internal timer events fire automatically.

scxml.description: SCXML content (creates fresh session). Omit to use existing session.

source.description: Use source="editor" to simulate the editor document without resending SCXML

delay.description: Delay in ms before sending this event (0 = immediate)

awaitStable.description: Wait for the machine to reach a stable state after all events (no pending delayed sends, no enabled eventless transitions). Useful for machines with <send delay="..."/> that continue processing after the last external event.

stableTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time (ms) to wait for stable state when awaitStable=true. Default: 30000ms.

embedTrace.description: If provided, automatically embed the execution trace after the scenario completes

tools.name: scxml_sim_get_state
tools.description: Get the current simulation state without sending an event. Returns activeStates, variables, enabledEvents, and invokedInstances (active child machines with their invokeId and activeStates). Set includeHistory=false to save tokens.

includeHistory.description: Include full trace history in response. Set false to save tokens when you only need current state.

tools.name: scxml_sim_status
tools.description: Get a lightweight status summary of the current simulator session: sessionId, started/finished/mode, activeStates, and the identity of the loaded SCXML (scxmlHash, scxmlContentLength, machineName, stateCount). Use after scxml_sim_start to verify that the simulator is actually running the SCXML you expect — sessionId is reused across loads, so it is not by itself proof that new content was picked up. Does NOT return the SCXML body; use scxml_sim_get_loaded_source for that.

tools.name: scxml_sim_get_loaded_source
tools.description: Return the SCXML currently loaded in the simulator session, along with its identity (scxmlHash, scxmlContentLength, machineName, stateCount). Use this to confirm which version of a document the simulator is actually evaluating — particularly when scxml_sim_start was called with source="file" and the file on disk has changed.

tools.name: scxml_sim_reset
tools.description: Reset the simulation session to its initial state.

tools.name: scxml_sim_explore
tools.description: Exhaustive bounded exploration of a state machine. Systematically tries ALL enabled events at each configuration up to maxDepth using BFS. Discovers: all reachable state configurations, deadlocks (non-final states with no enabled events), unreachable states, and invariant violations with counterexample event sequences.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

signatureMode.description: How to identify "same state": active_states_only (fast), active_states_and_variable_hash (default), active_states_and_variables (precise)

invariants.description: ECMAScript boolean expressions checked at every state. Use In("StateId") for state membership. Example: !(In("DoorOpen") && In("Moving"))

eventData.description: Maps event names to arrays of data variants. Each variant becomes a separate exploration edge. Example: {"call": [{"floor":0,"dir":"up"}, {"floor":1,"dir":"down"}], "select": [{"floor":0}, {"floor":1}]}. Events NOT in this map are sent without data (as before).

tools.name: scxml_sim_fuzz
tools.description: Random fuzz testing: generates random event sequences from enabled events. Each run picks a random enabled event at each step, checks invariants, and reports first violation with counterexample trace. Complements scxml_sim_explore by covering rare event orderings.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

invariants.description: ECMAScript boolean expressions checked at every step

eventData.description: Maps event names to arrays of data variants. A random variant is selected each time the event is chosen. Example: {"call": [{"floor":0,"dir":"up"}, {"floor":1}]}

tools.name: scxml_generate
tools.description: Generate code for a target language from SCXML. Returns UTF-8 source files inline and base64-encoded binary artifacts with an explicit encoding field. Use source="editor" or source="file" to avoid passing raw SCXML content. Set outputDir to write files to disk and avoid token overflow.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content. Omit when using source="editor" or source="file".

source.description: Where to get the SCXML: "inline" (from scxml parameter), "editor" (fetch from connected editor), or "file" (read from file path)

file.description: File path to read SCXML from (only used when source="file")

plcPlatform.description: ST target only: codesys (default, 3rd ed. with METHODs), iec-strict (no pragmas/access modifiers), openplc (2nd ed. FUNCTIONs, no METHODs)

tracingMode.description: Java/C#: Trace instrumentation level. "minimal" (default) enables addTraceListener with ~1ns overhead. "none" disables all tracing. "full" supports multiple concurrent listeners.

snapshot.description: Emit snapshot/restore hook overrides on the generated class (history map + native variable accessors). Pair with the language's SnapshotService at runtime (Java/C#/JS/Python/Go all ship one). Off by default — non-snapshot consumers pay zero code-size or runtime cost.

hierarchy.description: Emit state-hierarchy metadata and navigation APIs. Off by default so generated output retains its lightweight code-size and runtime footprint.

wasmProfile.description: Wasm target only: opt into a versioned direct-Wasm profile. Use full-hosted@1 for ECMAScript and host services, or finite-null-static@1 for restricted i32-only static run-to-completion. Omit for flat-null-memoryless@1 compatibility. Call scxml_list_targets for exact per-selector contracts.

allowUnsupported.description: Expert override: generate an unsupported target/datamodel pair and preserve error diagnostics in generator.json and the tool result.

outputDir.description: Write generated files to this directory instead of returning inline content. Recommended for large outputs.

tools.name: scxml_list_targets
tools.description: List available code generation targets and their options.

tools.name: scxml_compare_traces
tools.description: Compare two execution traces and report differences. Pass trace entry arrays directly, or use expectedName/actualName to reference embedded traces by name (avoids resending data through the LLM).

expected.description: Expected trace entries (use this OR expectedName)

actual.description: Actual trace entries (use this OR actualName)

expectedName.description: Name of an embedded trace to use as expected (requires active simulation session)

actualName.description: Name of an embedded trace to use as actual (requires active simulation session)

normalize.description: Normalize traces before comparing: maps transition_fired↔transition, filters action_execute/event_processed. Use for cross-target comparison.

mode.description: "full" compares all entries; "state-sequence" compares only state_enter/state_exit; "structural" collapses repeated loops and compares structure (ignores loop counts)

tools.name: scxml_trace_list
tools.description: List all embedded traces in the current SCXML document. Requires an active simulation session.

tools.name: scxml_trace_embed
tools.description: Embed a trace into the SCXML document. Provide JSONL content to embed an external trace, or omit content to embed the current session execution history. Use target to control where traces are persisted.

content.description: Raw JSONL trace content to embed. If omitted, the current session execution history is used.

target.description: Where to persist the trace: "simulator" (in-memory only), "editor" (pushed to editor for save), or "both" (default)

tools.name: scxml_trace_delete
tools.description: Delete an embedded trace from the SCXML document by name.

tools.name: scxml_trace_get
tools.description: Get an embedded trace by name. Set metadataOnly=true to return just {name, entryCount, description} without the full entries (saves tokens). For comparison, prefer scxml_compare_traces with expectedName/actualName instead of fetching traces manually.

metadataOnly.description: Return only metadata (entryCount, description) without trace entries. Saves tokens.

tools.name: scxml_trace_play
tools.description: Start playback of an embedded trace by name. The simulator will replay the trace with state updates broadcast in real-time.

speed.description: Playback speed multiplier (1.0 = real-time, 2.0 = 2x speed). Default: 1.0

tools.name: scxml_trace_step
tools.description: Step forward or backward through a loaded trace. Returns the current position and trace entry.

delta.description: Steps to move: positive = forward, negative = backward

tools.name: scxml_sim_set_variable
tools.description: Set a variable value during simulation. The variable must exist in the state machine datamodel.

tools.name: editor_push_scxml
tools.description: Push SCXML content to the VSCXML-Generator editor for the user to see and edit. The editor will update its SCXML input pane.

scxml.description: SCXML XML content to push to the editor

tools.name: editor_get_scxml
tools.description: Get the current SCXML content from the editor. Use stateId for partial retrieval, includeTraces=false to strip embedded trace data (saves tokens).

stateId.description: If provided, returns only this state subtree instead of the full document

includeTraces.description: Include embedded trace data in the response (default: true). Set to false to save tokens.

tools.name: editor_show_notification
tools.description: Show a toast notification in the VSCXML-Generator editor UI. Useful for status updates.

tools.name: editor_highlight
tools.description: Highlight specific states in the VSCXML-Editor canvas. Used to draw attention to states during explanation or debugging.

color.description: Highlight color: hex (#ef4444) or preset (error, success, warning, info, active, danger). Default: blue.

duration.description: Duration in ms (0 = persistent until cleared)

tools.name: editor_add_note
tools.description: Add a note/annotation to the VSCXML-Editor canvas. Notes can be attached to states and conditionally visible by state or variable expression.

attachedTo.description: State ID to attach the note to (moves with state)

visibleWhen.description: Only show when these state IDs are active

visibleWhenExpr.description: Variable expression for visibility (e.g., "errorCount > 0"). Evaluated against live datamodel variables during simulation.

tools.name: editor_remove_notes
tools.description: Remove notes previously added by MCP from the editor canvas. Call with no noteIds to remove all MCP-added notes.

noteIds.description: Specific note IDs to remove (omit to remove all MCP notes)

tools.name: editor_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the VSCXML-Editor canvas to show specific states or fit the entire diagram.

fitStates.description: Fit view to show all these states

tools.name: editor_save_file
tools.description: Save SCXML to disk. With content omitted, saves the current editor document and associates that path with it. Explicit content is saved as a separate file without retargeting the open editor document.

filePath.description: Absolute file path to save to

content.description: Explicit SCXML for a separate-file save. Omit it to save and associate the current editor document.

tools.name: editor_load_file
tools.description: Load an SCXML file from disk into the editor. Returns the file size on disk (diskLength) AND the size the editor reports it loaded (contentLength). When the two differ, the editor failed to fully import the document — see vscxml-preview#1.

tools.name: editor_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of the editor viewport. Set outputPath to write PNG to disk instead of returning base64 inline (saves tokens).

outputPath.description: Write PNG to this file path instead of returning base64 inline. Saves 10-50K tokens.

tools.name: editor_connect_simulator
tools.description: Connect the editor to the simulator backend so it shows live state highlights during MCP-driven simulation.

tools.name: editor_disconnect_simulator
tools.description: Disconnect the editor from the simulator backend. Stops live state highlights.

tools.name: editor_pull_from_simulator
tools.description: Pull Simulator → Editor for the complete SCXML document: logic, notes, layout, embedded traces, and extensions move together. The default confirm=false is compare-only and never overwrites; when copies differ it returns the whole-document diff and a comparisonId. To replace the editor document, call again with confirm=true and that exact comparisonId. The editor rechecks both copies and rejects stale confirmations, so unsaved editor-only changes are never silently overwritten.

confirm.description: Compare only by default. Set true only after reviewing the returned whole-document diff.

comparisonId.description: Opaque ID returned by the immediately preceding compare-only call; required with confirm=true.

tools.name: editor_push_to_simulator
tools.description: Push Editor → Simulator for the complete SCXML document: logic, notes, layout, embedded traces, and extensions move together. The default confirm=false is compare-only and never overwrites; when copies differ it returns the whole-document diff and a comparisonId. To replace the simulator document, call again with confirm=true and that exact comparisonId. The editor rechecks both copies and rejects stale confirmations. A confirmed replacement resets the simulator runtime.

confirm.description: Compare only by default. Set true only after reviewing the returned whole-document diff; replacement resets runtime.

comparisonId.description: Opaque ID returned by the immediately preceding compare-only call; required with confirm=true.

tools.name: editor_get_selection
tools.description: Get the current selection state in the editor — selected states, transitions, canvas controls, and MCP highlights (with colors). Also includes the latest buffered selection event from user clicks.

tools.name: editor_get_viewport
tools.description: Get the editor viewport: visible area, zoom level, pan offset. Also returns the latest buffered selection and document change events.

tools.name: editor_auto_layout
tools.description: Trigger automatic layout of the diagram in the editor. Rearranges states for clean visual presentation.

algorithm.description: Layout algorithm: elk (professional, default), hierarchical (quick), grid

tools.name: editor_add_state
tools.description: Add a new state to the diagram. Use parentId to add as a child of a compound/parallel state (auto-positioned if x/y omitted). Returns the created stateId for use in transitions and property edits.

x.description: X position on canvas (auto-positioned inside parent if 0 and parentId set)

y.description: Y position on canvas (auto-positioned inside parent if 0 and parentId set)

parentId.description: Parent compound/parallel state ID — adds as child (overrides coordinate hit-testing)

id.description: Desired state ID (auto-generated if omitted). Must be a valid XML ID.

tools.name: editor_add_transition
tools.description: Add a transition between two states. Returns the created transitionId. Optionally set event and guard condition inline (saves a separate set_property call).

tools.name: editor_set_property
tools.description: Set properties on a state or transition. For states: label, color, x, y, width, height, onentry, onexit. For transitions: event, cond, actions, type. Use elementQuery instead of elementId to find elements by properties (e.g. {source:"Idle", event:"start"} for transitions, {label:"Idle"} for states).

elementId.description: State or transition ID (use elementQuery as alternative)

elementQuery.description: Find element by properties instead of ID. For transitions: {source, event, target}. For states: {id, label}.

tools.name: editor_add_control
tools.description: Add an interactive input control or live variable display widget to the editor canvas. Controls can attach to a state and use parent-relative geometry. Buttons send static eventData; toggle/slider/text inputs can merge their live value under dataField. All non-button types may bind to a datamodel variable. Returns controlId.

controlType.description: Input control or display widget type

event.description: SCXML event sent by an input control

eventData.description: Static object merged into the sent event data

dataField.description: Field receiving the live toggle/slider/text value

binding.description: Datamodel variable/path read by widgets or written by inputs

color.description: Outer background color: theme token such as theme:fill:3 or a CSS color

textColor.description: Outer text color: theme token such as theme:text:2 or a CSS color

groupId.description: Shared group ID for controls that should select, move, and resize together

attachedTo.description: State ID to attach the control to; x/y then become parent-relative

locked.description: Lock the control against editing in the canvas and property panel

tools.name: editor_set_control_property
tools.description: Update any properties of an existing canvas control/widget, including geometry, eventData, variable binding, range, formatting, colors, and visibility.

properties.description: Properties to merge into the control

tools.name: editor_remove_control
tools.description: Remove an interactive canvas control or live display widget by ID.

tools.name: editor_add_image
tools.description: Add an image to the editor canvas. Provide base64 data OR a filePath (editor reads from disk). Use visibleWhen for state-dependent visibility, visibleWhenExpr for variable-based visibility.

data.description: Base64-encoded image data (no data: prefix). Required if filePath not provided.

filePath.description: Absolute path to image file on disk. Editor reads it directly (avoids base64 in MCP channel). Required if data not provided.

attachedTo.description: State ID to attach the image to

name.description: Display name for the image (shown in structure panel). Default: "mcp-image"

states.description: State IDs — image visible when any of these are active

negate.description: If true, image is HIDDEN when states are active

visibleWhenExpr.description: Variable expression for visibility (e.g., "temperature > 50"). Evaluated against live datamodel variables during simulation. When combined with visibleWhen, both conditions must be true.

tools.name: editor_set_image_property
tools.description: Modify properties of an existing image on the canvas. Use to change position, visibility rules, opacity, etc.

attachedTo.description: State ID to attach to (null to detach)

visibleWhenExpr.description: Variable expression for visibility (e.g., "temperature > 50"). Set to null to clear.

tools.name: editor_remove_element
tools.description: Remove a state, transition, image, or note from the diagram. Removing a state also removes its children and connected transitions. Removing an image garbage-collects its stored data when no other placement references it. Use editor_list_images to find image IDs; images return their ID from editor_add_image.

elementId.description: ID of the element to remove (state / transition / image / note ID)

tools.name: editor_list_images
tools.description: List all images currently on the editor canvas with their IDs and metadata (name, position, size, attachedTo, opacity, rotation, mimeType, visibility rules). Handy after several editor_add_image calls to locate IDs for editor_set_image_property or to clean up via editor_remove_element (elementType "image").

tools.name: editor_group_images
tools.description: Group 2+ canvas images under a shared group so they select, move, and resize together as one unit (like Affinity). Returns the new groupId. Get image IDs from editor_list_images or editor_add_image.

imageIds.description: IDs of the images to group (at least 2)

groupId.description: Reuse/assign a specific group id (default: a fresh one is generated)

tools.name: editor_ungroup_images
tools.description: Ungroup images — either a specific set of image IDs (clears their group) or an entire group by groupId. Provide imageIds OR groupId.

imageIds.description: Image IDs to remove from their group

groupId.description: Ungroup every image in this group (from editor_list_images)

tools.name: editor_clone_state
tools.description: Clone/duplicate a state with all its children, internal transitions, onentry/onexit actions. The cloned state is placed near the original.

sourceId.description: ID of the state to clone

newId.description: ID for the cloned state (auto-generated if omitted)

tools.name: editor_export_svg
tools.description: Export the current diagram from the editor as a complete SVG. Returns parseable text the agent can read directly — contains state IDs, labels, positions, transitions, colors. Set includeSimulationState=true to preserve current active-state highlighting; the default is a clean design diagram. Set outputPath to write to disk instead.

outputPath.description: Write SVG to this file path instead of returning inline content.

includeSimulationState.description: Include current simulator active-state highlighting (default: false).

tools.name: editor_export_png
tools.description: Export the current diagram from the editor as a full PNG image at 2x resolution. Unlike editor_screenshot (viewport only), this renders the entire diagram. Set includeSimulationState=true to preserve current active-state highlighting; the default is a clean design diagram. Set outputPath to write to disk instead.

outputPath.description: Write PNG to this file path instead of returning inline content.

includeSimulationState.description: Include current simulator active-state highlighting (default: false).

tools.name: editor_export_player_html
tools.description: Export a self-contained interactive HTML player for the current state machine. The HTML includes embedded SVG, SCXML, and JavaScript runtime for live simulation and trace playback. Opens in any browser with zero dependencies. Set outputPath to write to disk instead.

exportMode.description: interactive = live simulation, traces = recorded playback, both = switchable

selectedTraceIds.description: Trace IDs to include when exportMode is "traces" or "both"

runtimeMode.description: interpreted = embed the SCXML plus the parser and interpreter; compiled = embed a generated JavaScript machine instead (smaller, no parse at start-up). Compiled needs the generator service and silently falls back to interpreted; the reported runtimeMode says which one was produced.

outputPath.description: Write HTML to this file path instead of returning inline content.

tools.name: editor_status
tools.description: Check if the VSCXML-Generator editor is running and connected.

tools.name: editor_get_console_log
tools.description: Get console log entries from the editor. Returns timestamped log entries from simulation, validation, notifications, and trace playback. Useful for debugging and monitoring state machine execution.

level.description: Filter by level: info, warn, error, debug. Omit for all.

search.description: Text search filter across message and source.

limit.description: Max entries to return (default 200, from most recent).

tools.name: editor_add_log_entry
tools.description: Write a log entry to the editor console. Appears in the Console tab and is persisted for the session.

level.description: Log level: info (default), warn, error, debug.

source.description: Source tag shown in brackets, e.g. "mcp" (default).

tools.name: editor_get_notifications
tools.description: Get active notifications and document validation results (errors and warnings) from the editor.

tools.name: scxml_status
tools.description: Check the connection status of VSCXML backends (generator, simulator, editor). Reports URLs, available tool groups, and how to start missing backends. Call this first to know which tools are available.

tools.name: scxml_help
tools.description: Get workflow guidance for using VSCXML tools effectively. Returns best practices, step-by-step workflows, tips, and common pitfalls. Call with no topic for an overview, or specify: design, simulate, generate, trace.

topic.description: Workflow topic: overview (default), design, simulate, generate, or trace

instructions: VSCXML provides local tools for designing, validating, simulating, visualizing, and generating W3C SCXML. Call scxml_status first. Use only tool groups whose backend is connected; start the VSCXML app when one is missing. Prefer source="file" or source="editor" over pasting large XML. Validate before simulation or generation, then verify behavior with scxml_sim_scenario. Ask before a destructive tool overwrites or deletes files, documents, traces, or editor elements. Use scxml_help for detailed workflows.
